api_base.description: The URL of the Onyx Guard server. If not provided, the `ONYX_API_BASE` environment variable is checked.

api_key.description: The API key for the Onyx Guard server. If not provided, the `ONYX_API_KEY` environment variable is checked.

timeout.description: The timeout for the Onyx Guard server in seconds. If not provided, the `ONYX_TIMEOUT` environment variable is checked.
